title: Double Time (Gladiator)
problem: The extra copy of a Trick-slot debuff goes through the buff routine. It skips debuff immunity and resistance, "on debuff" effects don't fire for it, and "on buff" effects do. That matches the report.
notes: Community claim: Its debuff copy triggers "when a buff is gained" effects (Be Careful What You Wish For, Glitch in the System). Evidence: bc_EventDamage Trick block (L7922 / L8043): perk clause @0x140fcf171 -> bc_GetAlliesOf @0x140fcf44e -> call to bc_EventBuff (0x140ccac40) @0x140fcfd48 instead of bc_EventDebuff (0x140fdb040). Fix sketch: S: retarget the call at 0x140fcfd48 to bc_EventDebuff if the argument lists match (else H) Triage 2026-10-26: S: retarget the call @0x140fcfd48 from bc_EventBuff (0x140ccac40) to bc_EventDebuff (0x140fdb040); both take the same 9 arguments (checked: all 64 calls in bc_EventDamage pass 9). 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0129 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: Your Trick Slots that apply buffs and debuffs affect 1 additional creature.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the extra debuff was applied as if it were a buff: it skipped debuff immunity and resistance, and set off on-buff effects instead of on-debuff effects.
release_notes.fix: Now the extra debuff is applied as a normal debuff.
